track.title: Afshari: Daramad I
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: Daramads I, II, V vote E, Daramads III, IV, VI, VII vote B, the Forud votes F#. Vote kept.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on F# in Daramad I. The line peaks at Gs4 (413.4 Hz) at 0:01.3. It closes on B3, not the tonic (F#4 → F#4 → F#4 → F#4 → E4 → B3).
